name: Google Workspace

sso_url.label: SSO URL
sso_url.help: Found in Google Admin Console > Apps > Web and mobile apps > Your App > SAML > SSO URL

slo_url.label: SLO URL
slo_url.help: Google Workspace does not support SLO

certificate.label: Certificate
certificate.help: Download from Google Admin Console > Apps > Web and mobile apps > Your App > SAML > Certificate

setup_instructions: 1. Log in to Google Admin Console (admin.google.com)
2. Go to Apps > Web and mobile apps
5. Click 'Continue' on Google Identity Provider details page
6. Download Certificate and copy SSO URL and Entity ID
- Entity ID: Download from FreePBX SAML metadata URL
- Name ID: Basic Information > Primary email
11. Turn ON the service for your users/OUs
12. Enter the copied values in FreePBX SAML configuration
